clue.text: Side effect of being extremely busy at work

parts.note: a work is something produced, a product

explanation.surface: Being run off your feet at the office has its consequences.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' looks like an intensifier for 'busy', but it takes only the outside letters B and Y of that word.
explanation.definitionFit: A secondary result arising from a main process is an incidental side effect.

clue.text: Cliff's idle boast

definitions.meaning: a claim to strength or intent that is not backed up, made to deceive

explanation.surface: A man named Cliff is all talk.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun names a steep broad headland, and also the empty pretence of a poker player's bet.

clue.text: Plump for Hair when they open the doors

parts.note: to plump for something is to choose or pick it
locks are a person's hair

explanation.surface: Choosing a hairstyle to wear to a grand opening.
explanation.definitionFit: Burglars' tools, or the burglars themselves, that release a lock and so get doors open.

clue.text: Liberal work? Unusual: need labourer to get involved

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a musical work

indicators.note: to get involved signals the labourer is put in among the shuffled letters
unusual suggests the letters of need appear in an odd new order

explanation.surface: A generous employer finds it odd to need extra workers on a job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Liberal' looks political but means generous; 'Unusual' gives ENED and 'to get involved' wraps it round the labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: Being generous with money or gifts is being liberal, giving freely.

clue.text: Extraordinary international gathering is able to override New York

indicators.note: in a down answer, a piece that overrides another sits above it, so the earlier letters come first

parts.note: UN, the United Nations, gathers the world's nations
can means is able to

explanation.surface: A United Nations assembly is empowered to overrule the city it meets in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to override' is a down-clue placing: CAN rides over NY.
explanation.definitionFit: Something weird and beyond the ordinary is strange enough to be unsettling.

clue.text: Transporting and uplifting, it's old and new art

indicators.note: new indicates the letters that follow are made into a fresh arrangement

parts.note: 'n' is a casual abbreviation of and, as in rock 'n' roll

indicators.note: uplifting in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: 'tis is an archaic contraction of it is

explanation.surface: A museum review praising work that is uplifting and mixes old with new art.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it's old' is the archaic 'tis, which 'uplifting' turns into SIT; 'new' mixes N and art into TRAN. The 'n for 'and' is informal.
explanation.definitionFit: Transit is the act of carrying people or goods from place to place, i.e. conveyance.

clue.text: Good English required to read the paperback for the class

parts.note: read as 'the paper back': the Sun newspaper written backwards

explanation.surface: Good English needed for reading a cheap novel for school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'paperback' must be split as 'paper back': the Sun, a British tabloid, reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: In biological classification a genus is a rank of organisms grouping related species.

clue.text: Notes when in Georgia a Greek goddess

indicators.note: when in means the notes are put inside the state's abbreviation

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia
A and E are two musical notes

explanation.surface: Musical notes played in Georgia honour an ancient deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Gaea is the Earth personified, mother of the Titans in Hellenic myth.

clue.text: Sound hooter about one

indicators.note: about means the first word goes round the second

parts.note: hooter is slang for the nose
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A car horn gives a blast around one o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: Any audible thing heard, especially an unwanted din.

clue.text: Seattle's watchful?

parts.note: plays on the romantic film title about an insomniac widower in that city; staying watchful means staying awake

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who cannot sleep stays wakeful all night, and the 1993 film had the word before 'in Seattle'.

clue.text: Somewhere in Verdun Clemenceau has a relative

indicators.note: somewhere in says the letters are tucked inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A French wartime leader at Verdun has family there.
explanation.walkthrough: Verdun was the great First World War battle and Clemenceau the French premier, a fitting false scene.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent's brother is a family member, a kinsman.

clue.text: Stop shooting, call a halt to the hostilities

definitions.meaning: the command given to troops to stop firing

definitions.text: call a halt to the hostilities
definitions.meaning: a truce, an agreement ending fighting

explanation.definitionFit: As an order it tells soldiers to stop firing; as a noun it is a truce suspending war.

clue.text: Records the undernourished in Spithead's squalor

indicators.note: in places the thin people inside the records

parts.note: files are records kept on paper
underfed people are thin
read as 'Spit head's': the head, or first letter, of Spit

explanation.surface: Logs show the starving held in grim conditions at a naval anchorage.
explanation.walkthrough: Spithead is an anchorage off Portsmouth; split it as 'Spit head' for its first letter S.
explanation.definitionFit: Filthiness is dirtiness, the state of grime that squalor describes.

clue.text: Harvest variety of pear

indicators.note: variety of suggests a different arrangement of the letters of pear

explanation.surface: Gathering in a kind of pear from the orchard.
explanation.definitionFit: To reap is to cut and gather a crop.

clue.text: Market in Good Beer Guide for equestrians

parts.note: a mart is a market
ale is a kind of beer

explanation.surface: Pubs listed in the beer drinker's handbook sell to horse riders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Good Beer Guide', a real British pub guide, is broken up: Good is G, Beer is ALE, and Guide joins the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A strap from girth to noseband or reins that controls a horse's head carriage.

clue.text: Marshal the wine to begin with, making one that's fine with colour, perhaps

definitions.text: one that's fine with colour, perhaps

indicators.note: to begin with means the wine comes at the start, ahead of the marshal

parts.note: hock is a German white wine

explanation.surface: A French marshal opens a bottle and turns colourful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fine' points to fine art: David Hockney is a painter famous for vivid colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A painter works in the fine arts and uses colour, as the Yorkshire artist famously does.

clue.text: Yesterday in France saw Yonne's first under-bridge structure

indicators.note: in a down answer, a piece under another comes after it

parts.note: hier is French for yesterday
an arch is a bridge span

indicators.note: first takes just the opening letter of Yonne

explanation.surface: Yesterday a French traveller saw the river Yonne flowing under a bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: The Yonne is a French river, keeping the scene in France.
explanation.definitionFit: A hierarchy is an organised ranking system, a structure of levels.

clue.text: The Duck Step follows tango nonsense

indicators.note: follows puts the duck's step after the tango letter

parts.note: T is tango in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a waddle is the rolling walk of a duck

explanation.surface: A dance called the Duck Step comes after the tango at a ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Twaddle is silly talk, rubbish.

clue.text: Brave action, but died, going wrong at party

parts.note: erring means going wrong
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A heroic act that ended in death when a party went awry.
explanation.definitionFit: Heroic, daring exploits are what derring-do describes.

clue.text: Tucked into set tea on board; that is most relaxing

indicators.note: tucked into puts the inner piece inside the rearranged tea
set suggests the letters of tea are rearranged
on board means inside a ship, so the first piece goes inside the ship's letters

ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Afternoon tea served on a cruise ship is the most relaxing thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' conventionally means inside SS, a steamship; 'set' gives EAT, and 'Tucked into' puts SIES inside it.

clue.text: Curls from the direction of 2,perhaps

explanation.definitionFit: Long locks of hair, often in curls, are tresses.

clue.text: Disturbances leading to improvements in circumstances

definitions.meaning: upward turns in fortune or trade

explanation.surface: Upheavals that lead to better times.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun covers an upheaval or overturning, and also an upward trend in fortunes.

clue.text: Remove the spell copper runes made

indicators.note: made suggests the letters are made into a new word

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: Copper runes are made to lift a witch's curse.
explanation.definitionFit: To uncurse is to lift a malediction, to free from a hex.

clue.text: A pitch consisting of fine dust

parts.note: to shy is to throw or pitch

explanation.surface: A cricket pitch made of fine dust.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashy means like or made of ash, the powder left after burning.

clue.text: Got one in baseball who wrote lyrically?

definitions.meaning: hit a home run, the slang verb for which is the answer
the ancient Greek epic poet of the Iliad

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means hit a home run in baseball; as a name it is the epic poet of ancient Greece.

clue.text: Ranking level of a hundred from pile around centre position

indicators.note: around puts the word pile round the shuffled letters
position suggests the letters of centre are placed differently

explanation.walkthrough: 'of a hundred' belongs to the definition: a percentile ranks on a scale of a hundred; 'position' gives ERCENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A statistical rank that splits a population into a hundred equal parts.

clue.text: Spooky kind of boat on the lake

parts.note: an E-boat was a German fast attack boat

explanation.definitionFit: Eerie means strange and frightening, creepy.

clue.text: Sign that sentence is to be split, with one German force imprisoned by Russian leader — official

parts.note: a comma marks a break in a sentence

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of Russian

clue.text: Drill when gold legend is presented before the queen

read as 'leg end': the last letter of leg
ER, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.walkthrough: 'legend' splits as 'leg end', the final letter G.

definitions.meaning: units of length of three feet
